artifact_status: machine-reviewed source labels; not human gold

method.review_scope: Every source case was reviewed from its post text, available article title/preview, quoted-post text, and author/profile description.
method.blindness: No Jev predictions, assessment journal, run summary, other-agent labels, or model outputs were read.
method.definitions: Labels use QUESTION_SET in x_monitor/jev_decisions.py and the rare_type_extra_search fixtures as category-boundary definitions.
method.keep_policy: Keep actual AI personnel changes, credible concrete AI openings, specific AI attendance or participation events, bounded actionable AI opportunities, and named AI model or agent-harness releases with source evidence. Quoted announcements count.
method.drop_policy: Drop non-AI material, static bios, comparisons or price-only mentions without a release, unsupported recaps, generic commentary, unrelated crypto or sports collisions, and recruiter/job-mill noise.
method.uncertain_policy: Use uncertain when the available source fields do not establish the missing referent or source support. Link-only posts with unavailable destination text are unresolved, not junk.
method.provider_failure_note: The two provider failures mentioned by the assessment run are not relevant to these blind source-text labels.
